title: Segment
text:
A segment is a part of something which has been divided. On the AoPS Wiki, segment could mean many things:

  • Line segment - in Euclidean geometry, a subset of a line with two endpoints
  • Circular segment - The region bounded a chord of a circle and the arc formed by this chord
